youtube_short.title: Half of Retirees Were Forced Out — $312K Gone
title_alternatives: The Forced Retirement Trap Costing You $312,000
You Won't Choose When You Retire — And It Costs $312K
youtube_short.description:
Most people plan to retire at 65 assuming they control when it happens. The data says otherwise — half of all retirees exit the workforce involuntarily, on average 3 years before they planned. That early exit triggers a permanent 30% Social Security cut, plus three fewer years of compounding. Total damage? $312,000 per person on average. Here's the one thing you can do about it. #retirement #personalfinance #socialsecurity #money #financetips
